title: Distribution-free certificate of similarity between distributions with blurred total variation distance
abstract: arXiv:2602.05862v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Classical two-sample tests aim to determine whether two distributions are equal or not based on samples from each one. Even in an distribution-free setting, well-known methods such as the permutation test can provide statistical evidence that the two distributions differ. However, failure to reject equality does not necessarily establish that they are similar. In this work, we study the complementary problem of certifying distributional similarity with finite-sample confidence, without imposing assumptions on the underlying distributions. We show, however, that for continuous distributions, any distribution-free upper confidence bound on the total variation (TV) distance must be trivial with high probability, even if the distributions are identical. translated_title: 基于模糊全变差距离的分布相似性的无分布认证

tldr: 论文证明对连续分布而言TV距离的无分布置信上界必然平凡，从而提出用其松弛形式——模糊TV距离——在不做任何分布假设的情况下以有限样本置信度认证分布相似性。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that any distribution-free confidence upper bound on total variation distance must be trivial even for identical continuous distributions, and therefore proposes the blurred TV distance—a relaxation of TV—to certify distributional similarity with finite-sample confidence without any distributional assumptions.
